labels.note: Plain ask for time; sending the link is reversible and deterministic.
Negation rule: an explicit instruction not to move carries no move intent; third-party grumbling is not a complaint about us.
Live, reproduced defect; Max cannot diagnose. Broken promo code is a bug, not a commercial discount discussion.
Unambiguous request for time; send the scheduling link.
Retraction of an earlier move request; the reschedule intent is withdrawn, nothing left to act on.
Active breakage reported; hand over, do not attempt diagnosis.
Straight booking ask for a new session.
Negation plus deferral: explicitly told to hold off cancelling, so no cancel intent exists yet.
Failed test on our own work is a live blocker; a person must assess it.
Asking for time today; safe, reversible action.
Negation rule: emphatic instruction not to reschedule; the past-move anecdote is context, not a request.
"Is this normal" about broken-looking behaviour is a live problem report, not a documented process question.
Terse but unambiguous booking ask.
Explicit statement that nothing changed; no move, no commitment question, nothing to act on.
Data not updating as expected is a live defect; hand over.
Proposing a day is a booking ask; send the link.
Hypothetical plus explicit self-negation ("this is not me saying so"); no pause intent.
Ongoing hardware/output failure affecting operations; live problem, relayed but ours to hand over.
A held slot with an invitation to decline is still a scheduling ask; confirming is reversible.
Hypothetical kills the booking intent, but the buried question asks what added cadence would mean on our side, i.e. scope.
Explicitly asks for our judgment on a metric shift; advice plus a possible live problem, both hand-over.
Availability ping; treat as a booking ask.
Outage is hypothetical so no problem intent, but the live question asks for coverage assurances Max must not give.
Resolved rule: self-diagnosed and closed, so no live problem; the apology warrants a reaction, not a reply.
Direct request for availability; send the link.
"Don't build it" negates the build, not the question; a feasibility/scope ask still needs a person.
Device-specific failure plus a request to explain it; Max must not diagnose.
Booking a session with their colleague is still our meeting, not the third-party case.
Third-party internal meeting plus a lateness heads-up; no request to move or cancel ours.
Explicitly still happening, so not resolved; live problem.
Asking for an hour this week is a booking ask.
Third-party vendor's call, explicitly disclaimed as not ours; no intent.
Resolved rule: prior report retracted after clean-window retest; only an apology remains, so react.
Request to put a recurring slot on the books; a scheduling action, reversible.
Third-party meeting between their vendor and their staff; involvement is conditional and future.
Reported figure changing for a fixed day is a live data defect; Max must not explain or reassure.
Availability ask for today.
Relayed acknowledgement of receipt; react, do not compose a reply, and nothing is requested.
Scoped down but explicitly still asking someone to look; live problem, not resolved.
Direct request for an invite; send it.
Their internal staffing issue, explicitly flagged as nothing for us; no intent.
Partial failure with a hanging state; live defect for a person.
Offering a day and a format is a scheduling ask; acting is reversible.
Idiom plus past/resolved: a decision signed off months ago, no live request.
"Maybe intentional" hedging over unexpected behaviour is the policy's live-problem case, not a process question.
Shifting an existing call; send the link.
Reads as a request for a record that may not exist; answering means asserting an unverifiable fact, so hand over.
Stated loss of trust in the deliverable plus an underlying data defect; both hand-over intents.
Blanket reschedule request; workload venting is not dissatisfaction with us.
Instruction to disregard a stale document; nothing to act on and no question asked.
Correction of an earlier report that keeps the defect live and adds a hypothesis; still a problem.
Request to shift an existing slot later.
Past internal event, explicitly no follow-up; nothing actionable.
Records arriving in an unusable state; live defect blocking their operations.
Existing session must shift for attendee availability.
Status FYI: their own review queue, not a dispute or liability, so not lane D; the second blocker is theirs and owned.
Duplicate transaction with evidence; live defect. Reference codes are not the ID/card/bank/password data lane D covers.
Reordering two existing sessions is a reschedule.
Explicitly asking for the team's view on a judgment call; Max must not opine, hand it to a person.
Two surfaces disagreeing is a live defect; low urgency does not change the lane.
Recurring clash with a proposed alternative day; reschedule.
Idiom rule: "the booking system is down" is a genuine outage despite the wry framing.
Refined repro that explicitly remains wrong; the correction narrows the bug, it does not resolve it.
Request to shift the existing slot later; hyperbole is not a complaint.
Idiom is defined for us as discuss-not-defer, so no cancel or move; but the referent is unstated so the intent cannot be settled.
Unexplained self-correction of data; the client states the concern is live, so this is not the resolved case.
Reschedule of an existing planning session to a named date.
Negation scopes to the first clause only; the second clause is a live problem report.
Hedged self-doubt over reproducible broken behaviour is a live problem, per the reading rule.
Swap of an existing time; reversible scheduling action.
Repeat-ask framing is an escalation signal; the underlying defect is still open.
Asks for readiness assurance against a date and reports repeated failures; Max may neither reassure nor diagnose.
Reschedule to next week; the courtesy check does not change the intent.
Sarcasm about elapsed time is dissatisfaction with responsiveness; intent, not wording, decides.
Small defect is still a defect; severity does not move the lane.
Cancellation: act on it and post it internally, since it is a health signal the owner needs.
Sarcastic remark about growth in the spec is dissatisfaction with how the work is going.
Balance wiped beyond what was spent is a live defect; an email address is not the ID/card/bank/password data lane D defines.
Cancels an existing call; cancel and rebook, and notify.
Disclaimed criticism is still criticism of how we deliver; the disclaimer does not neutralise the intent.
Duplicate step questioned as unintended behaviour; a live problem, not a documented process answer.
Cancels this week's session; act and notify.
Joke, self-retracted in the same breath; the urgency marker is noise, nothing actionable.
Regression of a closed defect with identical behaviour; live again, so the resolved rule does not apply.
Cancels a recurring session; act, offer rebooking, and notify.
Cross-account exposure is a severe live defect; the message carries no ID/card/bank/password, so lane D does not fire.
Behaviour causing downstream tickets is a live problem regardless of whether it matches the spec.
Cancels today's call; act and post internally.
Self-labelled minor, but a long-standing miscount in a reported figure is a live defect; Max must not size it.
Two compounding live defects with a concrete customer impact; hand over.
Instruction to take tomorrow's session off is a cancellation; act and notify.
Billing and payment-method topic, which is hand-over; a last-four reference is not a card number, so lane D does not fire.
Hedged performance-degradation report with a request to investigate; the disclaimer does not remove the problem.
Cancels an existing session; act and notify.
Explicit hold pending a proper message later; the deferral removes any live intent.
Impact was absorbed but the client explicitly wants the defect closed; still live.
Cancels this week's session with reasoning; act, offer rebooking, notify.
Explicitly reassigned internally and disclaimed for us; no live intent.
Broad live breakage plus a request to reshape the work; scope is hand-over and Max cannot agree to it.
Direct cancellation of a named session; act and post internally.
Negation means no cancel; confirming calendar state is safe and verifiable, but the spreading internal friction must be flagged.
